biography.plain_text: Pasquale Natuzzi is an Italian furniture entrepreneur and designer who founded the Natuzzi group in southern Italy. The son of a cabinetmaker, he opened a Taranto workshop at nineteen and developed an international manufacturing business, retaining control after its New York listing. His company's headquarters remain in Santeramo in Colle.

long_biography.plain_text:
Pasquale Natuzzi helped make leather sofas an attainable purchase for American households by supplying Macy's with competitively priced Italian upholstery. He established a New York distribution company to serve that market, then widened the business across Europe and Asia. The American operation gained offices and a showroom in High Point, North Carolina, designed by Mario Bellini.

Natuzzi remained personally involved in product styling, brand development and relationships with major customers. He also invested in professional training for the people who made and sold the furniture. The University of Bari recognised that work with an honorary degree in education.
